_nitro.pageTitle: About — Viktor Nešić, Senior Mobile Engineer

about.headline: Mobile apps that ship, and keep working long after they do.
about.lead: I'm Viktor, a senior mobile engineer with more than ten years in software and over twenty apps delivered across iOS, Android and Kotlin Multiplatform, from enterprise products for international brands to MVPs built from a blank page.
about.benefitsTitle: What you get when you bring me in

benefits.title: Native quality on both platforms
benefits.text: Swift, SwiftUI and UIKit on iOS, Kotlin and Jetpack Compose on Android. Business logic shared through Kotlin Multiplatform where it pays off, native where users can feel the difference.

benefits.title: A safe pair of hands for existing code
benefits.text: I have audited and maintained inherited apps, from legacy Objective-C to modern SwiftUI, and turned them into clear risk reports, maintenance plans and estimates before any work starts.

benefits.title: Data that works offline and integrations that hold
benefits.text: GraphQL and REST, OAuth and OIDC sign-in, Firebase, push notifications, and offline catalogues synchronised with SQLDelight for teams working in the field.

benefits.title: Releases taken care of
benefits.text: TestFlight builds for QA, App Store and Google Play releases, dependency and OS updates: the unglamorous work that keeps a production app healthy.

benefits.title: Accessibility built in, not bolted on
benefits.text: Screen-reader semantics from the first component. I maintain an open-source accessible OTP library and have reviewed accessibility across enterprise design systems.

benefits.title: Clear communication with your team
benefits.text: Years of working alongside designers, QA, product owners and clients across Europe. I review code, mentor juniors and have run senior mobile interviews.

process.text: Understand the product, the users and the existing code before writing any.
Native interfaces on a clean, testable architecture, shared where it makes sense.
Builds in QA's hands early and releases prepared with care.
Updates, fixes and improvements that keep the app reliable.

form.title: Have an app to build, rescue or scale?
form.text: Tell me about it. I usually reply within a day.
